description: Reads the value of whatever param or port the mouse is over, displays it, and sends it out as CV

params.text: Picks when the module reads what the mouse is over: always on on, only with shift held on w/shift, or never on off, where it starts, despite the manual saying it defaults to w/shift
Sets the range the scaled output is mapped into: -5/+5, 0/+10 or -10/+10, which it starts on

outputs.text: Carries the raw value of the param or port under the mouse, with no scaling, so it can go outside -10V to 10V
Carries the value under the mouse rescaled from that control's own lowest and highest values into the range set by the SCALED OUTPUT switch; a port is treated as running from -10V to 10V

notes: VALUE, MIN, MAX and DEFAULT show the hovered control's current value and its lowest, highest and default values, and TYPE says whether it is a param, an input or an output.
the value is read at the screen refresh rate, around 60 times a second, rather than at the audio rate, so an audio signal tapped this way comes out heavily aliased.
the module comes up with its enable switch at off and reads nothing until that switch is moved to on or to w/shift
menu: Show Tooltip — floats a label beside the hovered control with its name, value and description; it is on to begin with
